sponsored.t: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
sponsored.sum: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises at 22 N Main Street in the village of Florida, county of Orange.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023 and 2024 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024, 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 school taxes for two parcels of land located at 67 and 71 College Road in Monsey.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of her deceased husband with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax freeze credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax freeze credit for taxpayers in certain eligible school districts.

sponsored.t: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the legislature to four years
sponsored.sum: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the legislature to four years and limit the terms of office a member of the legislature may serve.

sponsored.t: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits
sponsored.sum: Provides for any city, town or village in the state of New York to control the town speed limits.

sponsored.t: Authorizes local school districts and municipalities to determine and establish school speed limits
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local school districts and municipalities to determine and establish school speed limits.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an electoral voting system for electing the governor, lieutenant-governor, comptroller and attorney general
sponsored.sum: Establishes an electoral voting system for electing the governor, lieutenant-governor, comptroller and attorney general.

sponsored.t: Requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "educational equity and choice act"; requires nonpublic schools to provide the same services that public schools currently provide to nonpublic schools; provides that such costs shall be approved by the commissioner of education and borne by the state; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the animal abuse hotline
sponsored.sum: Establishes the animal abuse hotline.

sponsored.t: Relates to consents to public utilities; licenses and easements
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to consents to public utilities, licenses and easements; allows the commissioner or other state agency to grant a county a license or easement for any public purpose or to construct or maintain sewers, water and property.

sponsored.t: Relates to repealing the driver's license access and privacy act
sponsored.sum: Repeals the driver's license access and privacy act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of certain services to students in nonpublic schools in certain school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of certain services to students in nonpublic schools in certain school districts.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the imposition of service charges upon certain real property
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the imposition of service charges upon certain real property.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption from suspension of driver's license for persons serving on fulltime active military duty
sponsored.sum: Provides exemption from suspension of a driver's license for persons serving fulltime active military duty who fail to pay fines from traffic or parking violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the election by certain counties to withdraw from the metropolitan commuter transportation district, and permits the counties of Orange and Rockland to make such election
sponsored.sum: Relates to the election by certain counties to withdraw from the metropolitan commuter transportation district; permits the counties of Orange and Rockland to make such election.

sponsored.t: Relates to the collection of supplemental vehicle registration fees for New York City registrants; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the collection of supplemental vehicle registration fees for New York City registrants.

sponsored.t: Relates to liability for outside aid
sponsored.sum: Relates to liability for outside aid.

sponsored.t: Relates to the limit upon real property tax levies by local governments
sponsored.sum: Relates to the limit upon real property tax levies by local governments; exempts real property owned by a city, town or village from taxes for infrastructure, road maintenance, snow removal, capital projects, consent order and smart growth initiative expenses and any extraordinary expenses required to respond to public health emergencies and pandemics.

sponsored.t: Relates to party nominations for candidates by county party committees
sponsored.sum: Relates to party nominations for candidates by county party committees.

sponsored.t: Relates to advertising for bids and offers; letting of contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to advertising for bids and offers; letting of contracts; raises the aggregate amount for sealed bids above the current levels for commodities from $20,000 to $80,000 and public works from $35,000 to $125,000.

sponsored.t: Increases civil service credits given to veterans currently returning from service
sponsored.sum: Increases civil service credits given to veterans currently returning from service.

sponsored.t: Relates to additional credit allowed veterans in competitive examinations
sponsored.sum: Relates to additional credit allowed veterans in competitive examinations; expands the definition of "veteran" and "non-disabled veteran" to include the spouse and/or children of a member of the armed forces of the United States who served therein in time of war and was subsequently killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Provides judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders and increases the lengths of certain prison sentences; repealer
sponsored.sum: Provides judges more discretion regarding securing orders and limiting the lengths of certain orders; increases the lengths of certain prison sentences; repeals certain provisions relating to use of force by law enforcement; repeals certain provisions relating to access to premises for discovery by the defendant and motions to vacate judgments.

sponsored.t: Designates black dirt as the state soil and to designate the black dirt region as home to the most fertile soil
sponsored.sum: Designates black dirt as the state soil; designates the black dirt region as home to the most fertile soil.

sponsored.t: Discontinues service fees for distinctive license plates issued to veterans
sponsored.sum: Discontinues service fees for distinctive license plates issued to veterans.

sponsored.t: Authorizes imposition of life imprisonment without parole sentence for persistent violent felony offenders; repealer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes imposition of life imprisonment without parole sentence for persistent violent felony offenders upon conviction of a violent felony offense when such person has previously been subjected to two or more predicate violent felony convictions.

sponsored.t: Elevates killing a police work dog or police work horse from being a class E felony to a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Elevates the offense of killing a police work dog or police work horse from being a class E felony to a class D felony; establishes the class E felony of injuring a police work dog or police work horse for intentionally causing serious physical injury to a police work dog or police work horse while such dog or horse is performing its duties under the supervision of a police officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the criminal possession of fentanyl
sponsored.sum: Provides that criminal possession of fentanyl is a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities located in the county of Orange and county of Rockland to charge for the cost of providing additional police protection to paid-admission events
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities located in the county of Orange and county of Rockland to charge for the cost of providing additional police protection to paid-admission events.

sponsored.t: Relates to school property and real property taxes
sponsored.sum: Relates to school property and real property taxes; establishes the blue ribbon commission on property tax reform; relates to state assistance for local real property reassessment, state assistance to assessing units within a school district, providing a fixed real property assessed value for residential real property owned by certain persons over the age of 65 and providing state reimbursement to municipalities for lost real property tax revenue; requires the state to fund certain programs mandated for municipal corporations or school districts.

sponsored.t: Creates the "I love NY outdoors" program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates the "I love NY outdoors" program; such program shall require the commissioner of economic development to develop a marketing strategy that would promote New York as a premiere destination for hunting and fishing; appropriates $2,500,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the New York small business relief fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York small business relief fund consisting of monetary penalties imposed by the state liquor authority to provide grants to small businesses which have suffered economic hardship as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

sponsored.t: Relates to dimensions and weights of vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to dimensions and weights of vehicles.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Defund Municipalities that Defund the Police Act" which provides for a withholding of a certain amount of state funding for a defunding municipality.

sponsored.t: Creates a religious exemption to the ban on fossil fuel equipment and systems
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the purposes of allowing the installation and use of fossil-fuel equipment and building systems where such are installed and used in a building or part of a building that is owned or occupied by a person who holds genuine and sincere religious beliefs and whose health and safety will be jeopardized due to the prohibition of the installation of fossil-fuel equipment and building systems because of such genuine and sincere religious beliefs.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting certain counties from the metropolitan commuter transportation district supplemental registration fee
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the obligation for motorists in certain counties to pay the metropolitan commuter transportation district supplemental registration fee.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a tax exemption for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers in a county with a population of more than 250,000 and less than 500,000 persons.

sponsored.t: Establishes the fourteenth judicial district
sponsored.sum: Establishes the fourteenth judicial district which shall consist of the counties of Putnam, Dutchess, Orange and Rockland.

sponsored.t: Relates to tethering restrictions and outdoor shelter requirements for dogs
sponsored.sum: Relates to dog tethering and restraint restrictions and outdoor shelter requirements for dogs that are left outdoors.

sponsored.t: Relates to the award of competitive civil service status for the spouse or children of military service persons killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Relates to the award of competitive civil service status for the spouse or children of military service persons killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Relates to state reimbursement for local enforcement of navigation laws on waterways within local jurisdiction
sponsored.sum: Permits municipalities within certain counties to apply for reimbursement from the state for law enforcement activities on waterways within their jurisdiction.

sponsored.t: Relates to community preservation funds for the town of Wawayanda
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Wawayanda to establish community preservation funds; establishes a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in said community preservation fund.

sponsored.t: Enacts Caylee's law; establishes the crime of failure to report a child's disappearance or death
sponsored.sum: Enacts Caylee's law; establishes the crime of failure to report a child's disappearance or death, a class D felony; makes exception where child dies while under the medical care of a licensed physician.

sponsored.t: Relates to apportioning funds to the East Ramapo central school district for services and expenses
sponsored.sum: Provides that the East Ramapo central school district shall be eligible to receive an apportionment of funds to be used for services and expenses; directs certain reports to be submitted.

sponsored.t: Exempts daycare facility and childcare facility employers from providing for COVID-19 sick leave
sponsored.sum: Exempts daycare facility and childcare facility employers from providing for COVID-19 sick leave.

sponsored.t: Permits public schools to utilize or display indigenous names
sponsored.sum: Permits public schools to utilize or display indigenous names.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the village of Greenwood Lake, county of Orange to allow golf carts on certain streets
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the village of Greenwood Lake, county of Orange to allow golf carts on certain streets under the exclusive control and jurisdiction of such village.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Affordable NY act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Affordable NY act"; increases the STAR exemptions; adjusts personal income tax rates.

sponsored.t: authorizing Liliana Fernandez-Clemente, the widow of Daniel Clemente, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Liliana Fernandez-Clemente, the widow of Daniel Clemente, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system on behalf of such deceased member.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Appalachian Trail
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of state highway 284 in the village of Unionville, county of Orange, to the Appalachian Trail.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Warwick to use preservation funds for water quality improvement
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Warwick to utilize preservation funds for the implementation of water quality improvement projects.

sponsored.t: Permits the town of Tuxedo to file liens on real property related to the towns sewage-works corporation
sponsored.sum: Permits the town of Tuxedo to file liens on real property related to the towns sewage-works corporation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Yeshivas Nachlas Sofrim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Yeshivas Nachlas Sofrim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the county of Orange to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the county of Orange to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes; provides for the use of the tax funds collected.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Ramapo to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Lev Teen Center
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Ramapo, county of Rockland, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Lev Teen Center.

sponsored.t: Ratifies and confirms the creation of water district no. 14 of the town of Monroe; and authorizes the issuance of bonds or notes by such town to finance certain inter-fund borrowings by such water district
sponsored.sum: Ratifies and confirms the creation of water district number 14 of the town of Monroe, made up of the water system previously owned and operated by Orchard Hill Water Company and which has been owned and operated by the town of Monroe by mandate from the public service commission since 2013; authorizes the issuance of bonds or notes by such town to finance certain inter-fund borrowings by such water district.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to an occupancy tax in the city of Port Jervis
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to an occupancy tax for hotels and motels in the city of Port Jervis.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Rockland to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Rockland to impose an additional rate of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.
